// Calendar: which booking holds which room on which night. A night is the Int day it starts on.
signal hold_nights(booking: String, room: String, from: Int, to: Int) -> Bool   // Calendar
    // Holds every night from <= d < to of `room` for `booking` and returns true — or, if any of
    // them is held already, returns false and holds nothing.
    requires from < to
writes     nights: Map<String, String> [persistent]   // "<room>@<day>" -> booking id holding that night
calls      is_free(room: String, from: Int, to: Int) -> Bool   reads nights
               // true when no night d with from <= d < to is held for `room`.
               requires from < to
called by  Bookings.book
